title: The Salt Sanctuary
subtitle: A fragrance journey through the quiet salt flats of Busan.
line: A sanctuary of absolute serenity where the scent of the sea dissolves into the white expanse.
quote: In the vast silence of salt, even the smallest essence becomes an infinity.
synopsis: You step into a world of blinding whiteness, where the stillness of a salt desert greets you. Guided by a path of silence, you approach the pristine white salt mound standing as a solitary monument in the center. As you circle this void, you discover hidden perfume vessels nestled within the landscape, waiting to be found. Every breath here is a meditation, a delicate balance between the vastness of the space and the intimacy of the scent.

why.d: A floor strip (pathway of silence) runs 4.7 m from the door toward the hero (pristine white salt mound). This path draws you into the space, grounding you in the profound stillness of the salt desert.
The hero stands alone 5.6 m inside the door, 3.5 m tall; nothing else rises above 1.8 m. This towering, pristine white salt mound creates a focal point that anchors the vast, empty room.

Four product stations (subtle hidden perfume vessel) ring it loosely, 0.4 m from the route at the closest. These subtle vessels encourage a tactile exploration of the space, turning discovery into a ritual.
The pay counter (minimalist transactional block) sits at the back right, where the route ends. The minimalist block offers a quiet, final anchor before you leave the sanctuary of the salt.

materials.name: Snow-white monolithic finish
materials.where: floor, walls, ceiling, minimalist transactional block

stops.cap: I step onto the path, and the world behind me fades into silence.
stops.sub: The floor strip guides me toward the heart of the desert.

stops.cap: Before me, the massive salt mound rises, a quiet testament to stillness.
stops.sub: It feels as if the salt has reclaimed the space, leaving only the memory of fragrance.

stops.cap: I reach out, and the vessel reveals itself, a hidden treasure among the grains.
stops.sub: The scent lingers in the air, barely whispered, waiting to be found.
